name: Tata Power
title: Press Release Titled "Financial Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026."

read.thesis: Record Q2 PAT of ₹1,652 crore (+33% YoY) but EBITDA up only 5% to ₹4,245 crore; capex ~₹10,000 crore in H1 with prior-guided renewable, rooftop and Shirwata items not restated in the release.

capex.quote: Capital Expenditure close to ₹10,000 Crore in H1 FY27 & on track to meet annual guidance

triggers.label: H1 capex ~₹10,000 crore
triggers.quote: Capital expenditure of ~ ₹10,000 crore in H1 FY27 reflects accelerated execution across renewable energy

triggers.label: 765 MW Clean & Green added in H1
triggers.quote: Installed 765 MW of Clean & Green generation capacity in H1 FY27, taking the total installed Clean & Green capacity to 8.6 GW

triggers.label: Shirwata capital commitment board-approved
triggers.quote: Board approval secured for the capital commitment for the Shirwata project

guidance.value: on track to meet annual guidance (no figure restated)
guidance.quote: on track to meet annual guidance

prior_guidance_check.quote: on track to meet annual guidance

red_flags.label: EBITDA growth lags PAT growth (5% vs 33%)
red_flags.quote: EBITDA increases 5% YoY to ₹ 4,245 crore during Q2 FY27

red_flags.label: Mundra under Section 11 directive till December end
red_flags.quote: runs currently under Section 11 till December end

adds.what: 765 MW Clean & Green generation capacity installed in H1 FY27 (total 8.6 GW)
Shirwata project (capacity size not stated; board-approved capital commitment)

growth.why: Management says H1 FY27 capex of about ₹10,000 crore is on track for the annual capex guidance (no figure restated), and 765 MW of Clean & Green capacity was added in H1 to reach 8.6 GW, with Shirwata board-approved but no size or timing given.
